text:
Mia: Quick heads-up — CloudX + SI Summit next week. We're planning a private-offer push tied to the hardware partner launch. Need final commit tiers, renewal language, and an announcement cadence. Who's up for pricing band sign-off?

Alex: I can take pricing band sign-off. Want to propose 3 tiers and run by finance/legal.

Ravi: From sales POV we need clear renewal uplift language (auto-renew vs opt-in) and something for early-convert credits. Otherwise field gets messy.

Emily: Legal can draft the renewal snippets but need specific discounts + term lengths. Share exact numbers asap.

Samir: I'll own HW partner messaging and the joint announcement coordinate. Need SKU binding details from ops.

Jordan: Ops will map SKUs to marketplace listings. Question: do we publish separate SKUs for Dedicated vs Hosted offers? That affects billing.

Alex: Good Q. My recommendation: publish separate SKUs to avoid meter conflation. Ops: confirm feasibility.

Jordan: Feasible. Adds ~2 days to QA for marketplace listing sync.

Mia: Can someone sketch the commit tiers here so Legal / Finance have something concrete? Minimal marketing-friendly copy would help too.

Alex: Draft tiers below — open to edits.

```
Tier Alpha — $500k annual commit -> 25% discount + 3 months onboarding credit (applies to Hosted + Dedicated), 12-month term
Tier Beta  — $150k annual commit -> 15% discount + co-sell credit, 12-month term
Tier Gamma — $40k annual commit  -> 6% discount + pilot support credits, 6-month term
```

Ravi: Beta looks reasonable for mid-market SI deals. Suggest adding a renewal incentive: 5% extra discount for 12-month renewal within 30 days of expiry.

Emily: Legal flagged: onboarding credit needs a clear expiry / non-transferability clause. Also we should avoid open-ended co-sell credits in the PO language. I'll draft required lines if you confirm numbers.

Samir: HW partner asks for co-branded announcement on day 1 and a joint case study 3 months after launch. We should add a clause for mutual approval window (48 hrs) on messaging.

Alex: OK to add 48-hr review window for partner messaging. Also propose a soft cap on co-sell credits per customer to limit cost exposure — say $30k per account.

Mia: Action items: Alex — finalize tiers + cost modeling; Emily — draft renewal & credit T&C; Jordan — SKU split plan; Samir — partner comms timeline; Ravi — field enablement bundle.

Mia: Target: lock by EOD Friday so Marketplace team can start listing next Monday. Anyone blocked?

Jordan: No blocker from ops, but we need final SKU names by Thursday EOD.

Ravi: I'll prep enablement slides and two sample renewal scripts.

partners-bot: Private-offer draft sent to CloudX slack thread (link: https://cloudx.example/po-draft). Note: CloudX requested a 30-day review window for their legal.

Emily: 30-day review is long; propose 10 business days + one extension. Will flag in draft.

Mia: Sounds good. Let's avoid ad-hoc exceptions — keep the standard 10bd + 1 ext. If CloudX pushes, escalate to me. :thumbsup:

Alex: I'll update the tier doc, run numbers with finance, and post the updated doc here by Thursday morning.

Mia: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. We'll aim to publish the private offers and announce jointly on the partner page the week after Summit.

Samir: Noted. I'll schedule the joint announcement dry-run with CloudX comms for Thursday.

Mia: Closing note — avoid the term "kicker" in external comms; use "co-sell credit" or "onboarding credit" instead.

Alex: Got it.

Mia: Locking this thread as the single source for price/announce decisions. If anyone posts contradicting numbers, flag me.

Ravi: +1

Emily: +1

Jordan: +1

Samir: +1

partners-bot: Reminder set — follow-up check Friday 09:00 PT.
